envelope.description: HandlingReport, parseHandling, mergeHandling, applyHandling and the report head line

body.title: HandlingReport, parseHandling, mergeHandling, applyHandling and the report head line
body.summary: Type HandlingReport with budgets in their own units, optional trigger, combineStages and 'mixed'; add parseHandling (malformed value read as absent), mergeHandling (prefix-qualified part ids, budgets de-duplicated per unit), applyHandling (handling plus one incomplete source note per uncovered part, complete false) and the single handling line in renderReportHead; type AnswerReport.handling and merge it in mergeAnswerReports without changing its signature.
acceptanceChecks: parseHandling reads a stored {} and any malformed value as absent and accepts a record with and without trigger
mergeHandling keeps units apart, qualifies part ids with the plan path and returns 'partitioned' for a single-pass root with a partitioned child
applyHandling sets complete false and adds an 'answer step / <part id>' note per uncovered part without mutating its input
renderReportHead is unchanged for a report without handling and adds one line with it

tests.name: handling-report.test.ts: parseHandling reads {} and malformed values as absent and accepts a record with and without trigger
handling-report.test.ts: mergeHandling keeps units apart, de-duplicates budgets, sums combineStages, gives 'mixed' and keeps plan-qualified part ids distinct
handling-report.test.ts: applyHandling sets complete false, adds one 'answer step / <part id>' note per uncovered part and does not mutate its input
handling-report.test.ts: renderReportHead is unchanged without handling and adds one line with it; mergeAnswerReports keeps its binary signature
handling-contract.test.ts: HandlingReport against the sc4 sketch plus additive fields, bundle schema open handling object still valid
